GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "How are you?"? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Tag
   B. Wie geht's?
   C. Ja
   D. Guten Abend

2. Which German word or phrase means "see you soon"? (1 mark)
   A. Bitte
   B. Bis bald
   C. Ja
   D. Danke

3. Which German word or phrase means "grandmother"? (1 mark)
   A. der Vater
   B. die Oma
   C. der Bruder
   D. die Tochter

4. Which little word goes with the noun "Opa"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

5. What is the plural of "der Baum"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bäumen
   B. die Baume
   C. die Baums
   D. die Bäume

6. What is the plural of "die Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. die Türen
   B. die Türer
   C. die Türs
   D. die Türe

7. What does "riechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to help
   B. to eat
   C. to play
   D. to smell

8. Which German word means "to drink"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. schlafen
   B. hören
   C. trinken
   D. lesen

9. What does "der sechste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fourth
   B. sixth
   C. first
   D. seventh

10. What does "Ich möchte singen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I would like to sing
   B. I like the song
   C. I sang
   D. I am singing

11. Which food group does "die Bohne" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

12. Which meal word contains the special letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Abendessen
   B. Mittagessen
   C. Frühstück
   D. Brot

13. Which form completes "Obst ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. bist
   C. bin
   D. sind

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Schulter"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. den
   D. das

15. Which German word or phrase means "back"? (1 mark)
   A. das Auge
   B. der Bauch
   C. der Rücken
   D. das Knie

16. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. ein
   B. einem
   C. eine
   D. einen

17. What does "heiß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. windy
   C. hot
   D. dry

18. Which weather sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Regnet heute es
   B. Es heute regnet.
   C. Heute es regnet.
   D. Heute regnet es.

19. What does "zwischen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. under
   C. on
   D. in front of

20. Which completes "Der Ball ist ___ Garten"? (1 mark)
   A. auf der
   B. im
   C. in der
   D. an die

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

22. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

24. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

25. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

26. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

27. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

28. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)

29. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)

30. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Wie geht's?
   How are you? in German is Wie geht's?.

2. B — Bis bald
   see you soon in German is Bis bald.

3. B — die Oma
   grandmother in German is die Oma.

4. D — der
   It is der Opa, so the little word is der.

5. D — die Bäume
   The plural of der Baum is die Bäume.

6. A — die Türen
   The plural of die Tür is die Türen.

7. D — to smell
   riechen means to smell.

8. C — trinken
   to drink in German is trinken.

9. B — sixth
   der sechste means sixth.

10. A — I would like to sing
   möchte means would like to.

11. A — das Gemüse
   die Bohne belongs to das Gemüse.

12. C — Frühstück
   Frühstück (breakfast) has ü. Mittagessen and Abendessen have none.

13. A — ist
   Obst is treated as one group, so we say ist.

14. A — die
   It is die Schulter, so the little word is die.

15. C — der Rücken
   back in German is der Rücken.

16. C — eine
   Nase is a die word, so we say eine.

17. C — hot
   heiß means hot.

18. D — Heute regnet es.
   regnet is the second word.

19. A — between
   zwischen means between.

20. B — im
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).
